description: Sequencer modelling liquid running down a leaky pipe of eight cells, moving liquid from cell to cell on each clock tick and firing a gate wherever a cell empties

params.text: Sets how much liquid is added to the first cell on each tick, 0 to 1
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the FLOW input before it is added to the flow amount
Sets the volume a cell has to reach before it empties into the cell below and fires its gate, 0.001 to 10
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the VISC input before it is added to the viscosity

inputs.text: A voltage added to the flow amount, scaled by the slider for FLOW, with 10V covering the whole range at the slider's full setting
A voltage added to the viscosity, scaled by the slider for VISC, with 10V covering the whole range at the slider's full setting
A rising edge runs one cycle of the flow, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V

outputs.text: Eight channels, one per cell, carrying 10V on the ticks when that cell empties
Eight channels, one per cell, carrying the volume of liquid in that cell as 0-10V

notes: the square lights give the amount of liquid in each cell, brighter for a fuller cell
nothing moves until a clock is patched to CLK; the module has no clock of its own
FLOW starts at zero, so no liquid enters the first cell and no gate fires until FLOW is raised
